verdict.rationale: Rippling IT is an identity and access management product, so MFA policy is a fair axis. However, the evidence pack never mentions MFA, FIDO2 security keys, passkeys, or per-app policies that require phishing-resistant factors. The general 'custom security policies based on user and device attributes' claim is device-management policy, an adjacent feature that does not show this capability.

support.subject: As a security engineer, MFA goes beyond push codes — FIDO2 security keys and passkeys are supported and can be REQUIRED by policy for sensitive apps
